description: CLI that compiles a folder of SVG files into content-hashed SVG sprites, a manifest module and TypeScript types, plus @svgworm/react, a React Server Component adapter that renders the icons with zero client JavaScript.
rules: Run `svgworm init --yes` to set a project up non-interactively; add `--agents-md` for an AGENTS.md section.
Create the component once in a Server Component file with `createIcon(manifest)` from `@svgworm/react`, importing `manifest` from the generated `svgworm/icons.js`.
Run `svgworm` in `predev` and `prebuild`, and `svgworm check` in CI; `check` exits 1 when the committed output is stale.
The sprite must be served from the same origin as the page; with a Next.js `basePath`, pass it in `--public-path`.
Use `--json` for machine-readable output. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 invalid SVG, name collision, I/O failure or stale output, 2 usage or config error.
